reference_sql:
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS avg_budget_3m,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS months_in_window
FROM budget_monthly
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
alternatives:
WITH b AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month of 2025
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur
  FROM budget_monthly
  WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT m.channel_id, m.month, m.budget_eur, ROUND(AVG(p.budget_eur), 2) AS avg_budget_3m, COUNT(*) AS months_in_window
FROM b m
JOIN b p ON p.channel_id = m.channel_id AND p.month BETWEEN m.month - INTERVAL 2 MONTH AND m.month
GROUP BY m.channel_id, m.month, m.budget_eur

WITH w AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month of 2025
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
    AVG(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_3m,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM budget_monthly
  WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur, ROUND(avg_3m, 2) AS avg_budget_3m, n AS months_in_window
FROM w

other_way.tradeoff: Joining each month to the 2 months before it gives the same averages because every month has a budget row, but it needs a self-join.
